messages.content: We have n ≡ −1 (mod 2,3,4,5), so n+1 is divisible by 2,3,4 and 5. Hence n+1 is a multiple of lcm(2,3,4,5)=60, so n = 60k−1. The smallest positive choice is k=1, giving n = 59 (indeed 59≡1 (mod2), 2 (mod3), 3 (mod4), 4 (mod5)).
Thanks. Reply with the single word: bye
